collection.title: Ferrari 599 2007 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ferrari 599 2007 - 2012 requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
